newsitem.title: GERMANY: German network Kabel 1 can expand programming.
newsitem.headline: German network Kabel 1 can expand programming.

text.p: Private German television network Kabel 1 said on Thursday it had received permission from broadcasting authorities to increase the scope of its licence, allowing it to double the number of entertainment programmes.
The Bavarian State Centre for New Media (BLM) gave the green light to Kabel 1, owned by Pro Sieben Media AG.
The expansion of programming would include documentaries and news shows as well as comedies and dramas in the first half of this year.
"We expect this expansion of our programming to give us, along with an extraordinary chance for growth, an even more secure media-political position," said Kabel 1 head Ludwig Bauer.
The Pro Sieben group, which in 1996 posted its best returns, plans to go public on the Frankfurt stock exchange later this year.
